description: Read a full page, or one section, of the bundled Adobe Commerce documentation by id (from search-docs), source path or public developer.adobe.com / experienceleague.adobe.com URL. Use it after search-docs, or when the user pastes a docs link.

ref.description: Document id as returned by search-docs (e.g. "php/development/components/plugins.md"), source path (e.g. "commerce-php/src/pages/development/components/plugins.md") or public URL. Append "#anchor" to read one section.

section.description: Section anchor or heading to read only that section (e.g. "around-methods")

name: read-doc
title: Read an Adobe Commerce doc page
